svg.text: Base rail: angle 820 mm long, laid on the sheet down the slope,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 560 mm each side of the store's centre line, across the two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: purlins 700 and 0 mm from the roof's middle (60 mm past each).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw through the angle and a sheet crest into each purlin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top rail: angle 670 mm long under the panel's side edge; bolt

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the panel frame to it through the frame's own holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: flat bar 40 x 4 mm, 339 mm (high side) and 136 mm (low

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side), 25 mm in from the top rail ends. Each leg bolts to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upright flanges of both rails with one M8 bolt top and bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the leg holes on assembly so the panel sits at 15 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two frames are mirror images.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: panel at 15 degrees within 1; all bolts tight.
